rows.label: One department-designated theory course (check the department's yearly list)
rows.note: The department publishes the qualifying theory courses each year, so the board cannot tell which course counts.

rows.label: Five courses taken in the Comparative Literature department (Methods of Comparison counts as one)
Ten courses (30 credits minimum) in total, half of them read in a language other than English in the original
rows.note: Whether a course is read in its original language is not recorded on the roster.

rows.label: Literary Studies track: three COML courses plus five foreign-literature or humanities courses, all 2000 level or above, read in the original language
rows.note: One advanced foreign language course (conversation, composition) may be among the five. Which humanities courses qualify is a department judgment.

rows.label: Visual and Media track: two literary-study and six visual-arts or media courses, 2000 level or above, language component set with your advisor
rows.note: Which courses count as literary, visual arts or media study, and which satisfy the language component, needs the advisor and Director of Undergraduate Studies.

rows.label: Earn at least a C in every course counted toward the major
